ticket: WF-037, option 3: normalise preference fit by category breadth
problem: group_preference_fit divided matched styles by how many the owner named, so a category with more tags won more overlap for the same place quality

change.why_capped: past four the divisor stops discriminating and starts punishing richly-tagged categories, the mirror of the bug

side_effect: learned_category_bonus was unblocked — the owner's 71 peak rejections could not outweigh a 14-point structural gap on a 30-point dimension, and now they can

residual.finding: the head is now 12 museums tied at exactly 65.0, including the Postal Museum and a Miniatures Museum
residual.nature: a data limit, not a formula bug — all of them carry a Wikipedia article so is_city_icon is true for all, and open data offers nothing more to separate them
residual.ruled_out: the signal that would separate them is a commercial popularity measure the destination interview excluded

test_gap_closed.finding: the ranker's output ordering had NO test. The suite asserted the score was internally consistent — total equals dimensions minus deductions, true under any weighting — and never what was recommended.
test_gap_closed.negative_test: with the old denominator the landmark scores 55.3 against the peaks' 62.2 and loses

trip_unaffected.note: this changes what is offered, not what was chosen
